parole.significato: cardoon, artichoke thistle, any prickly perennial plant of the species Cynara cardunculus
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish كنكر (kenger, “cardoon”), from Classical Persian کنگر (kangar, “thistle; cardoon”), probably an ancient Aramaic borrowing.
Inherited from Ottoman Turkish كیرج (kirec, “lime”), from Classical Persian گِرَچ (girač), from Aramaic גִּירָא (gīrā), from Akkadian 𒌋𒀜 (gīru, kīru, “kiln”), from Sumerian 𒌋𒀜 (gir, “kiln”).
